assumptions.statement: The deployment environment includes legacy systems that require manual deployment steps, making automatic AMI changes disruptive.
assumptions.quote: due to the legacy nature of our deployments it causes issues with machines that need a number of manual deployment steps applied to them. Examples of these include the app servers and the puppet master.

assumptions.statement: Security vulnerabilities in older AMI versions can be mitigated by an existing overnight security patching process via Puppet.
assumptions.quote: We'd work around this in the same way we do our other environments; by using the overnight security patching we deploy via puppet.

assumptions.statement: The team prefers deterministic infrastructure states where changes only occur with explicit intervention, rather than dynamic updates.
assumptions.quote: This has the benefit that we know exactly which version we deploy and it cannot change without our intervention.
